intent: Open with exactly: "A debt collector keeps calling me at work." When asked who this would be against, say exactly: "It's Apex Collections." California. February tenth, twenty twenty six. If they ask whether this is employment, workers' compensation, or a job claim, say exactly: "No. It's a debt collector, not my employer." If offered the packet, say exactly: "Text is fine." Decline booking. Stay until they confirm the intake is on the file and the packet was sent by text. A spoken promise without those writes is not enough. Once finished, say exactly: "Thank you, that's all I needed." and end the call. The agent often says one moment or let me pull you up and then asks a question in the same turn. Always answer the question at the end of the agent's turn with the fact it asks for. Never reply with only "Sure", "Okay", "Yeah", or "Thank you" when the agent's turn ends in a question. Answer only the question the agent asks; do not repeat facts you already gave.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks for the caller's full name and a callback or phone number. NOT when asking about anything else.

The agent asks whether another lawyer or law firm currently represents the caller, whether any attorney represents you, or whether the caller has already hired or signed with anyone, even when the same turn starts with a filler such as one moment, let me pull you up, let me look you up, or I'll check that. NOT any other question.

The agent asks who the claim or matter would be against, who the other side is, or for the name of the debt collector or company this would be against, even when the same turn starts with a filler such as one moment, let me pull you up, let me look you up, or I'll check that. Also when they ask you to spell the company name. NOT when asking you to spell your own name. NOT any other question.
The agent asks which state this happened in, or where it took place. NOT any other question.

The agent asks when the incident happened, when the collector most recently called, when the calls started, or for a date, even when the same turn starts with a filler such as one moment, let me pull you up, let me look you up, or I'll check that. NOT any other question.
scripted_responses.response_value: It was February tenth, twenty twenty six.
